protocol.reference: Exact accepted role-v3 / conditional-points immediate composition; future expert unchanged in this experiment
protocol.selection: 2024/25 GW1-19 only; minimum relevant-weighted squared points error plus 0.5 multiclass participation Brier
protocol.acceptance: 2024/25 GW20-38 and independent full 2025/26; current completed 2026/27 is diagnostic only
protocol.folds: Expanding eight-deadline test blocks; labels from a target deadline, including both DGW fixtures, never enter its fit or calibration
protocol.point_gate: Both periods: upper 95% deadline-block relevant-weighted MSE delta below zero; all/regular/premium/position RMSE at most 1% worse; participation Brier no more than 0.002 worse
protocol.captain_gate: Whole-deadline paired captain difference interval wholly below zero is evidence of harm and rejects. An uncertain one-point aggregate change alone does not establish harm or superiority. Full legal-account policy and distribution gates are mandatory before any activation.
protocol.promotion: Only the independently selected overall winner is eligible; do not select a holdout winner after looking at acceptance results
protocol.adaptive: Disagreement-triggered mixture of frozen long and rolling-52 experts: min(0.75, total variation of participation + 0.25 min(1, absolute mean-point disagreement/3))
protocol.hybrid: H uses fixed 25% or 50% rolling expert. E upweights current-season fitting labels fourfold while preserving earlier historical rows. No player-specific overrides.
protocol.crossfit: Eight earlier calibration deadlines split into two blocks. Each calibration prediction is made by a model fitted before that block; final weights fit all earlier eligible labels. Calibrators never see in-sample predictions.
protocol.limits: Previously studied archives; this is reproducible historical reconstruction, not a blinded prospective performance claim.
